text:
maria: Quick ask from Nimbus SIthey're prepping artifacts for our joint marketplace listing and have a few unusual asks about HSM/KMS evidence and pen-test redaction. Can we align on what we will accept and what we want them to upload?
omar: Thanks Maria. Short list we'd share: SOC2 attestation summary, redacted pen report, vulnerability scan exports, KMS/HSM attestation (if used), and the partner questionnaire. Nimbus specifically asked if we need HSM key ceremony logs or just an attestation from their HSM provider.
lucy: We do not accept raw key ceremony logs. We accept a vendor attestation signed by their security contact + an inventory of key policies (rotation, custodians). If they want to provide logs, those must be redacted and go under NDA.
dan: Infra note  we can add a metadata envelope for each upload with fields: partner, artifact-type, env. Sample presign pattern we use:
```
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket rw-marketplace-artifacts --key nimbus/2026-03-21/pen-redacted.pdf --expires-in 3600
```
We'll set server-side encryption AES256 and tag uploads with `marketplace:nimbus`.
sec-bot: Required artifact matrix (v3):
- SOC2: attestation summary (presign) + full report (partner-upload, redacted)
- External pen test: partner-upload (redacted). If pen includes PoC exploit code, require separate NDA + contact.
- Vulnerability scans: CSV/JSON exports accepted; if Nessus/Qualys provide XML/CSV that's OK.
- KMS/HSM: vendor attestation + key policy export (presign). Key material or raw ceremonies NOT accepted.
- Partner questionnaire: presign (we store).
maria: Nimbus also wants to know retention window. What's our default TTL for partner artifacts?
lucy: Default retention for marketplace evidence = 12 months. For HSM attestations we keep metadata for 3 years but not raw key material. Legal can extend retention on case-by-case.
omar: Owners suggestion: Partnerships (omar) = partner comms + presign coordination; Eng-Infra (dan) = bucket + encryption + tags; Security (lucy) = redaction checklist + artifact acceptance; Legal = NDA and retention exceptions. Agreed?
dan: Also: we'll enable object-lock with a 7-day quarantine and automated virus scan lambda after upload. Presigned uploads expire in 1 hour; but we'll provide a refresh endpoint for the 7-day submission window.
lucy: Redaction checklist quick rules: remove cleartext credentials, redact internal-only IPs, remove stack traces that contain customer data, strip exploit payloads. Provide a redaction map (CSV) listing original->redacted token positions so Sec can audit. No screenshots as sole redaction.
maria: Great. One more item  Nimbus asked if we accept attestations from HSM-as-a-service operators (e.g., cloud KMS) or only on-prem HSM vendors.
lucy: Both accepted. Acceptable evidence: vendor-signed attestation, FIPS/HSM cert references, and key policy export. If they use cloud KMS, include the KMS resource ARN and IAM principals allowed.
sec-bot: Action items:
- Omar: send partner-facing checklist + presign template to Nimbus (due today)
- Dan: create bucket + object-lock + presign refresh endpoint (due tomorrow)
- Lucy: publish redaction map template + HSM attestation examples (due today)
- Maria: confirm retention requirements with Legal and post back (due EOD)
omar: I'll draft and post here in ~45m. Maria will review tone.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll loop Legal once Omar posts the draft. :thumbsup:
